streams.notes: Main + sub-agent complete wire event records. Main lives at agents/main/wire.jsonl; sub-agents at agents/agent-N/wire.jsonl (Agent tool, profiles coder/explore/plan — 0.38.0 subagent fixture writes agents/agent-0 with profileName=explore; origin.kind=system_trigger origin.name=subagent). Cold rebuild source of truth (packages/transcript). 0.38.0 hermetic types: metadata, runtime.set_binding, profile.bind, permission.set_mode, turn.prompt, context.append_message, plugin.session_start, context.append_loop_event (step.begin/end, content.part, tool.call, tool.result), llm.tools_snapshot, llm.request, usage.record, token_counting.measured, turn.ended (reason completed|failed; error payload on failed), token_counting.turn_recorded. Organic protocol-1.5 extras: prompt.accepted, tools.update_store, interaction.request/resolved, permission.record_approval_result, full_compaction.begin/complete, context.apply_compaction, config.update. Large media offloaded to blobs (blobref:<mime>;<sha256>). Tool results may spill to tool-results/.

Session metadata. Fixture fields: id, version, cwd, createdAt/updatedAt, archived, agents.<id>.{homedir,type}, custom, lastTurnReason (completed|failed), isCustomTitle. Sub-agent entries add parentAgentId and labels. Organic also writes title, lastPrompt, titleKind. Docs list forkedFrom (unseen in fixtures and organic census).
One homogeneous record per session: sessionId, sessionDir, workDir. No type discriminant. workDirKey = wd_<slug>_<sha256-12>.
Workspace catalog (fileWorkspacePersistence WORKSPACE_CATALOG_KEY). {version, workspaces.<workDirKey>.{root,name,created_at,last_opened_at}, deleted_workspace_ids}.
Install/device identity UUID (createKimiDeviceId).
One-shot thinking-effort migration markers (dynamic keys such as thinking-effort-max-to-high → ISO timestamp).
Per-session diagnostic log (kimi-code.log).
Global diagnostic log: startup, login, export, cross-session events.
Content-addressed media offloaded from wire (IAgentBlobService scope `blobs`; blobref:<mime>;<sha256>). Filenames are hex hashes. Binary/content — do not parse.
Spilled tool-result bodies (toolResultTruncationService scope `tool-results`). Names like <Tool>-<toolCallId>-<uuid>.txt. Free-text content — do not parse.
Per-workdir TUI input history, keyed by md5(workDir). Records are {content: string}. Free-text prompts — census skips this stream.
Per-workDirKey trust records {root, trustedAt} (workspaceTrust/trustRecord.ts). Filename is the workDirKey, no extension.
Persisted login-region marker (apps/kimi-code/src/utils/region.ts); organic value e.g. `cn`. Not written by the hermetic API-key farm.
Providers, models, loop control. Regular API keys live here — not in process.env. KIMI_MODEL_* synth is in-memory only. MAY contain secrets — inventory only, never parse.
TUI preferences including [upgrade].auto_install. Not written by headless -p.
Auto-update state (latest.json, install.json, install.lock, rollout.log, plugin-notices.json) — derived, excluded from harvest.
Managed rg/fd (and sometimes a kimi wrapper) vendor binaries — excluded from harvest.
Derived minidb query-store shards (cluster.meta.json, cluster.indexes.json, shard-*/db.wal + generations). Not SQLite. Excluded from harvest with cache/.
Cached client-config hints (e.g. estimated_cache_duration.json). Derived; excluded from harvest with cache/.
Banner display state at cache/banner/state.json (getBannerStateFile). Unseen in organic census and hermetic farm.
kap-server full-text search index (db.wal, db.textindexes.json, postings). Derived read model — excluded from harvest. Not SQLite.
Failed telemetry upload queue (cloudTransport FAILED_PREFIX failed_<id>.jsonl). May contain event payloads — do not parse. Excluded from harvest.
Managed OAuth blob store (distinct from credentials/). Organic file `oauth/kimi-code` has no extension. MUST-NOT-PARSE; excluded from harvest.
OAuth credentials (dir 0700, files 0600) including credentials/mcp/ — MUST-NOT-PARSE; inventory only, excluded from harvests.
TUI-only /goal next queue; not part of the agent conversation until promoted. Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
Plan-mode documents named by plan id. `--plan` does not combine with headless `-p`. Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
Versioned plan bodies offloaded from wire (plan.revision records). Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
Background task persistence: status/pid/exit code per task_id. Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
Background task output logs. Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
Scheduled-task persistence; reloaded on kimi --session. Farm sets KIMI_DISABLE_CRON=1. Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
User-level MCP server declarations; merged with project-local .kimi-code/mcp.json. Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
Installed plugin records and enabled state. Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
Vendor copies of plugins installed from zip/local paths — excluded from harvest.
Kimi-specific user-level Skills; generic .agents/skills stay under real HOME. Excluded from harvest.
Global Kimi-specific agent instructions. Unseen in fixtures and organic census.
kimi web persistent bearer token (`<KIMI_CODE_HOME>/server.token`, 0600) written on first web boot. MUST-NOT-PARSE. Not produced by headless -p.
kimi web instance registry (server/lock, server/instances/). Legacy vs current layouts differ. Not produced by headless -p.
Headless stream-json stdout — corroboration surface captured by the farm, not part of the agent data root.
